paragraphs: Rav Shimi of Birta de-Shechori. Mentioned in [Sotah 38b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sotah.38b.17).[^1][^2]

notes.text: Rav Shimi teaches the baraita about a synagogue made up of priests. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3308&lang=en) also records the Sotah reference.
Birta de-Shechori renders the place-name in Hyman. The linked Hebrew spells it de-Shichori.
